name: Weighted Stability Ball Overhead Crunch
steps: Sit on the ball holding the plate at your chest and walk forward until your lower and middle back rest on the ball.
Plant both feet wide and extend your arms overhead only as far as you can keep your ribs controlled.
Exhale and curl your rib cage smoothly toward your pelvis while keeping your arms locked straight alongside your ears.
Pause briefly at peak contraction, then lower your torso and overhead arms slowly back over the ball.
tips: Keep your arms extended steadily beside your ears rather than swinging the plate forward to yank yourself up.
Keep both hands firmly on opposite sides of the plate as it travels overhead.
